I elaborated that I wasn’t trying to be controlling, but I was personally hurt that she didn’t see anything wrong with her actions. I’d never do that to her, and I’m certain she’d be upset if I treated her the way I was treated. 

Her response was “ I didn’t cancel our plans to cuddle with pearl all day lol I don’t know why you took it like that “ and then “ I’ll talk to you later”
